channel.title: spawnpoint blog
channel.description: Notes from spawnpoint on small software.

item.title: Your apps can now keep their data and files
item.description: A spawnpoint app can now have its own database for things like lists and sign-ups, and its own file storage for things like photos and PDFs. Ask your agent for either one.

item.title: What small software is
item.description: Software for one purpose or a few people, which an AI agent can now write in an afternoon, and the four things it needs once it works.
